texts.m_text:
Update available!
Click to update your game to latest version

repairPriorities: Replace Nanum legacy Text with Linik Sans Black TMP SDF atlas and exact glyph metrics. The source font TTF is not embedded; original static atlas and character/glyph tables are recoverable.

Respect each TMP text element casing, autosize bounds, negative character spacing, bold flag, alignment, material outline/underlay and parent scale. Do not globally normalize every text to one font size/style.
Match original 1080x1920 per-canvas scaling (gameplay and many dialogs match=0.5, home and result=1.0) before copying anchors/offsets; current implementation uses match=0.0 globally.
Retain custom Coton loading/home art explicitly requested by user, while restoring compatible original UI typography and widgets.
interpretationNotes: Text strings in this audit are serialized authored values, including runtime placeholders (Level 45, currency1000, timer02:30) and debug panels. Runtime numbers must still come from progression/economy/timer state.
The font family/style names and glyph tables were read from both bundled TMP asset and main sharedassets0.assets:636; all274 scene TMP labels reference that font.
Do not replace custom Coton loading/home raster art; that is the explicit requested departure from reference.
A heavier APK does not itself improve font detail. Recovering the512px SDF atlas, glyph metrics, render material and layout produces the faithful typography without filler.
